messages:
lisa_partners: Quick sync request — we need to align vendor roadmaps + marketplace launch sequencing for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Main asks: embargo windows, SI cert timeline, and whether any firmware/driver slips will force a marketplace stagger. Who can join Thu 10am PT? cc @nvidia_vendor_rep

andrew_hwliason: I can make Thu 10am. Can we get a short pre-read? I want to avoid last-minute embargo changes.

raj_ops: Thu works for me too. Pre-read would be great — especially runtime perf delta between H100/H200 for our dedicated pools.

nvidia_vendor_rep: Thanks for the invite — I can join Thu. Quick heads-up: H200 driver release is tentatively delayed by ~2 weeks due to a microcode regression we found in long-run mem tests. We'll confirm by EOD tomorrow.

mike_platform: Noted. If H200 slips, we should plan an automatic fallback routing to H100 for Marketplace canaries. We have routing policy that can do region-level fallthroughs.

lisa_partners: @nvidia_vendor_rep thanks — can you add the driver/microcode PR link here when you have it? Also @mike_platform can you draft fallback policy options (short/medium/long) so we can show partners?

nvidia_vendor_rep: PR link will be posted once the engineering triage completes. For now assume a soft delay.

mike_platform: Will draft. Rough sketch:
```
- Short: soft embargo extension 1 week + staggered canary to smaller SI set
- Medium: marketplace flat delay for H200 in EU/APAC regions only
- Long: full regional stagger + cross-cloud announcement shift
```
I'll share a one-pager before the Thu sync.

devon_marketing: Heads up — our press window for the Q3 marketplace push is Aug 8–12. Any embargo shift >3 days will require rebook of briefing slots. Need firm dates by Fri COB. :calendar:

raj_ops: Also need to check SI certification lanes — Gaudi test harness still shows flaky driver load under high contended batching. If we delay H200/H100, that could free up lab slots for Gaudi but impacts SI timelines.

andrew_hwliason: Can eng-ml triage the Gaudi flakiness in parallel? If we can reduce test time by 30% we might absorb schedule pressure. @mike_platform can you include lab capacity delta in the one-pager?

mike_platform: Yup — will include lab capacity, canary bucket sizes, and routing policy examples.

lisa_partners: Action items before Thu 10am PT:
- @nvidia_vendor_rep: confirm driver/microcode PR + slip confirmation (EOD tomorrow)
- @mike_platform: share fallback options + lab capacity impact (pre-read by Wed EOD)
- @raj_ops: SI certification impact note (short bullet list)
- @devon_marketing: press window constraints + contingency ask (bullet list)

ci_cd_bot: deploy-bot: new doc PR created by mike_platform: refs/marketplace/fallback-onepager draft at https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace/pulls/412 :white_check_mark:

lisa_partners: Great — once we have pre-reads I'll compile a single slide for the partner sync. If driver slips, we'll discuss targeted regional staggering rather than a blanket delay. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
